description.value: Lee Garden Seafood is a Chinese dim sum and seafood restaurant located in Coquitlam's Pinetree Way area, serving both traditional dim sum and a full all-day menu with items like crystal prawn dumplings and sticky rice lotus leaf wraps. It is one of two Lower Mainland locations and offers online ordering with pickup. A touring cyclist passing through Coquitlam would find it a substantial sit-down meal option.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the Coquitlam location at 1163 Pinetree Way #2001 with phone +1 778-285-8900, matching OSM tags. The site shows an online ordering system with a 'Pickup 15 min' option, confirming takeout availability. No cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, washrooms) are mentioned anywhere on the website or in OSM tags.
